audience_logic.woman: - woman: Allow diverse silhouettes based on Yin/Yang balance, including A-line, fitted, flowing, waist-accentuating items, skirts, dresses, and delicate detailing, adjusting the strictness or softness based on the chosen Style.
audience_logic.man: - man: Anchor in classic menswear logic. Prioritize proper anatomical proportions, shoulder structure, and tailoring over trendy distortions. Use controlled silhouette volume.
audience_logic.not important: - not important: Activate relaxed-fit / unisex logic. Suppress hyper-gendered items (like dresses, skirts, or extreme tailoring) and favor versatile, gender-neutral staples like straight-leg denim, simple knits, and unstructured outerwear.

formality_logic.casual: - casual: Prioritize comfort, texture, and unstructured silhouettes. Favor materials like denim, corduroy, flannel, heavy/chunky knits, fleece, and jersey.
formality_logic.smart_casual: - smart_casual: Enforce the High/Low Balance Rule. Every outfit must mix elevated items (tailored blazer, refined trousers, cashmere) with relaxed items (premium sneakers, high-quality denim, casual knits).
formality_logic.formal: - formal: Enforce strict dress-code. Use worsted wool, silk, crisp poplin, and sharp creases. Favor darker, richer colors for base items. Only closed-toe leather footwear. Strictly suppress distressed materials, casual knits, and denim.

seasonality_logic.summer: - summer: Lightweight, breathable fabrics required (linen, cotton batiste, seersucker, tropical wool, silk). Suppress heavy midlayers and dark, heat-absorbing colors if possible.
seasonality_logic.spring_autumn: - spring/autumn: Light-to-medium layering; transitional outerwear (trench coats, light leather, denim jackets) preferred. Use medium-weight cottons and fine knits.
seasonality_logic.winter: - winter: Insulating layers and thermal logic required. Mandate heavy fabrics like tweed, flannel, cashmere, heavy wool, and corduroy.
